positions.role: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Platform Architecture and Data Security
positions.description: Platform architecture and data security for a mobility and payments company operating in East and Southern Africa.
achievements: Own the architecture of five web applications and a mobile API served from one PHP backend. The codebase carries 6,800 unit tests and 280 architecture decision records.

Designed the release process. Each release is an immutable directory activated by a symlink flip. A post-flip smoke test rolls back automatically on a real error. Deploy is one command and finishes in under a minute; rollback is one command.

Built the card top-up rail on Mastercard Payment Gateway Services hosted sessions, so card data never reaches our servers, keeping the platform in PCI DSS SAQ-A scope. Built M-Pesa STK and B2C, MTN and Tigo mobile money rails with per-country routing and idempotency that fails closed.

Designed a trust score engine that ingests signed, idempotent events from partner products into a hash-chained ledger and recomputes scores nightly for 40,000 users. Rolled it out behind feature flags to the admin console, rider portal and mobile API.

Hardened access and change control: key-only SSH with fail2ban, WebAuthn and TOTP MFA for admins, secret scanning and test gates in git hooks, pentest remediation, and encrypted nightly off-site database backups with restore drills.

Added Prometheus, Grafana and Loki to a legacy application without changing application code. Traced a database failover storm to a mis-sequenced reboot and fixed the liveness checks. Wrote the team's release and deployment guides.

positions.company: Ignite Energy Access (formerly ENGIE Energy Access)
positions.description: CI/CD and test automation for a pay-as-you-go solar platform in seven countries.
achievements: Owned CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure for Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Mozambique, Côte d'Ivoire and Zambia. Defined the testing standards and release gates engineering adopted.

Built end-to-end test suites in Playwright and Cypress for payment processing, token generation, subscriptions and IoT device provisioning. Regression moved from a multi-day manual cycle to an automated run on every pull request.
Led the Rails 5 to 7.2 upgrade across the payment, PAYG token, IoT diagnostics, subscription and firmware update systems, including multi-tenant configuration for each market.
Designed asynchronous token generation on RabbitMQ and a Redshift pipeline for payment events, which removed timeouts during peak billing. Managed a team of QA engineers.

positions.description: Founded the company and built its product: ML security testing for software in medical devices. Ran concurrently with Baw Bab.
achievements: Built the platform from scratch. It uses CNNs, retrieval-augmented generation and graph neural networks to detect adversarial attacks on ML models and to report gaps against HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and IEC 62304.

Designed the AWS backend in Python and Rust (PyO3) with a Go middleware layer for routing, rate limiting and fan-out to evaluation workers. Circuit breakers and back-off kept a live degradation invisible to customers.
Ran ML pipelines on Airflow with MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry and reproducibility.

positions.description: Digital addressing for last-mile delivery in informal urban areas. Ran concurrently with Vishnu Systems.
achievements: Built computer vision pipelines over Azure, Google and OpenStreetMap satellite imagery to detect residential structures and assign them Google Plus Codes.
Ran a pilot with the Nairobi County Government, the second digital addressing programme in Africa, integrated with county land registry records.

Owned the stack: React, Node.js, Kafka and MongoDB, with OpenAPI contracts and a Go backend-for-frontend separating the field agent mobile app from the county web console. Hosted on Azure, later Azure and GCP Cloud Run.

Worked on the Java microservices platform for actuarial, billing and reinsurance treaty processing. Defined service boundaries and data contracts with the architecture team, wrote integration tests and PostgreSQL migrations, and introduced OpenAPI and contract tests so services could deploy independently.

Founded a mentoring programme: 15 developers mentored through code review, system design sessions and career coaching, 6 of whom moved to mid or senior roles. Completed 80 technical certifications in cloud, backend, blockchain, AI and security. Built Go, Rust and Python projects for hackathons and open source.

Wrote C and embedded assembly for petabyte-scale video streaming pipelines with deterministic store-and-replay and zero frame loss. Designed redundant data paths and self-healing recovery for content delivery.

positions.description: Application security platform. Integrated static, dynamic and composition scanning into customer CI/CD pipelines.
achievements: Built the Jenkins, GitLab CI and Azure DevOps integrations that let customers run security scans inside their build pipelines. Worked on the monolith-to-microservices decomposition on Spring Boot, JPA and Hibernate with HATEOAS REST APIs.
Owned the Visual Studio plugin (.NET on Windows), including the TLS 1.2 enforcement upgrade for customers in regulated industries. Reviewed every feature against the OWASP Top 10 and NIST SSDF.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
honors: Microsoft Scholar and Google Scholar. Dean's List for nine semesters. Omicron Delta Kappa.
